answer: Social-graph-distance bond: each identity claims one atlas node, locking a 60-credit bond. A lantern beacon posts the distance table; a new node must sit three edges from any node sharing its funder, and auditors recompute it against the basalt ledger. Too close burns it. First fake pays 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented nodes fail since the funder link is public. Honest agents pay 35 once, bond kept.
